specification.family_title: Commit outcome after a connection or reply failure
specification.title: COMMIT completes on the server, and the network drops the reply before the client reads it
steps: Start a transaction with the framework's ordinary transaction API. The runner places a protocol proxy between the client and PostgreSQL.

End the transaction normally, so that the framework sends COMMIT. The proxy forwards COMMIT, reads PostgreSQL's reply through ReadyForQuery, does not write that reply to the client, and closes the client socket.
Checkpoint `after-end`, as soon as the API has returned: the runner records the state at report time.

invariants.statement: When the connection or PostgreSQL's reply was lost around COMMIT, so that the client never received an acknowledgement of COMMIT, the API does not report a successful commit.
When COMMIT may have reached PostgreSQL and no reply arrived, the API does not report a confirmed rollback, through its result, its errors, or its rollback hooks or events.

execution.description: MikroORM's defaults: em.transactional(callback) in a RequestContext, allowGlobalContext false. One non-default option is part of a case's form, not of the mode: the TX-02 cases call the nested em.transactional() with { clear: true }, as the reused experiments did, and each result records that form and its reason.

server.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg13+2) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

fault.mechanism: The runner's protocol proxy forwards COMMIT to PostgreSQL, then discards the reply through ReadyForQuery and closes the client socket. The client does not parse the reply. This is not the category D simulation, which closes the socket after node-postgres has already parsed the reply.
fault.injection_point: On the wire, after PostgreSQL has written the COMMIT reply and before the client reads it.
fault.expected_client: The connection closes where the reply to COMMIT would have been read.

knowledge: None at the API level: the reply to COMMIT was not delivered. Only a later read can establish that the transaction committed.

evaluation.reason: the adapter does not implement this case

reproduction.requires: pnpm run setup, then pnpm run pg:up (README.md)
